name: minimal-agent-monorepo
description: Umbrella monorepo: git submodules for minimal-agent + minimal-agent-plugins.

scripts.install:all: bun install --cwd minimal-agent && bun install --cwd minimal-agent-plugins
scripts.test: bun run --cwd minimal-agent test && bun run --cwd minimal-agent-plugins test
scripts.check: bun run --cwd minimal-agent check && bun run --cwd minimal-agent-plugins check
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd minimal-agent typecheck && bun run --cwd minimal-agent-plugins typecheck
